role: The generic 'M' variant (id + 128) of a base biome: copies the base's blocks, climate and spawn lists, raises its height, and delegates decoration, surface, tree choice, colours and class to the base object.
scope_reason: Overworld biome variants; all worldgen is vanilla (SPEC Decisions).

members.name: field_150611_aD
members.note: the base column of BIOMES; decorator.c base_of

members.name: BiomeGenMutated
members.note: height +0.1/+0.2 and copied climate are generated into BIOMES from the live objects; the copied spawn lists are spawning_list_for's (130's empty creature list, 134's slime row), checked for every id by test_biome_spawn.c against BiomeSpawnProbe

members.name: decorate
members.note: base decorator counts via deco_of(base_of(id)) run on the mutated object

members.name: func_150573_a
members.note: SURF_MUTATED recurses into the base, temperature included

members.name: func_150567_a
members.note: the base's tree kind and the base's big-tree state slot (slot_of)

members.name: getBiomeFoliageColor
members.note: RB_KIND_MUTATED recurses with (x, y, y), keeping the vanilla z-for-y slip; cov-foliage-s1: Swamp M grass, vines and leaves

members.name: getBiomeGrassColor
members.note: same recursion; cov-foliage-s1: Swamp M grass, vines and leaves

members.name: func_150562_l
members.note: cls column reports the base's class

members.name: func_150569_a
members.note: its only caller, GenLayer.func_151616_a, takes its first biome from GenLayerHills' and GenLayerBiomeEdge's parent output, where no id is 128 or above (mutated ids are first made in GenLayerHills itself), so it is never a BiomeGenMutated

members.name: func_150561_m
members.note: its only callers are GenLayerBiomeEdge.java:148-149 on the parent layer's ids, where no id is 128 or above, so never on a BiomeGenMutated

notes: Colour evidence is the mesh gate (test_meshes); whether a mutated-biome column appears in the mesh recordings was not checked. Closed by lane/idxworld (verification): the mutated biomes' terrain, decoration and colours are held by the chunk dumps of seeds whose regions hold them (out/java/chunks/junglem-123456789, spruce-123456789) and by test_populate; their spawn lists, the parent's copies, by test_biome_spawn.
